caption: The drawing features two metallic utensils, a fork and a spoon, presented horizontally and separated by a small distance on a plain, light beige background. The fork is positioned above the spoon, with both handles oriented towards the left side of the image and the functional ends facing right. The fork has three tines and a geometric, faceted handle, while the spoon below it also has a similar handle style and a rounded bowl. Both utensils appear to be rendered in shades of gray with subtle highlights and shadows that give them a metallic appearance. There is a small yellowish spot close to the center of the image, slightly below the fork and above the spoon. The artist's name, "ROSE CAMPBELL-CHENE," is written in capital letters in the lower right portion of the image. The overall composition is minimalist, with significant empty space surrounding the utensils.
title: Silver Baby Spoon and Fork
